senses.gloss:
√diś (diśáti; didéśa; ádikṣat, ádiṣṭa
[883]; dekṣyáti; diṣṭá; déṣṭum; -díśya;
diśyáte; deśáyati). point; direct; show.
[cf. δείκνυμι, ‘show’; Lat. dīco, ‘show,
tell’; AS. tāh, Ger. zieh, ‘pointed out (as
[]
guilty), accused’; Ger. zeigen, ‘show’;
also AS. tāh-te, tǣh-te, Eng. taught, ‘showed,
instructed’; AS. tācn, Eng. token.]
+ apa, show; make a false show of.
+ vy-apa, make a false show of.
+ ā, point out to, give a direction to,
direct.
+ sam-ā, point out to, direct; command.
+ ud, point out; aim towards; uddiśya,
w. acc., with an aiming towards, equiv. to
the prep. at, 26^22.
+ upa, show to, teach, instruct; give advice
to, advise.
+ pra, point out, designate; direct.

díś, f. just like Eng. point, i. e. cardinal
point, quarter of the heaven (N., E., S.,
W.); aṣṭau diśas, eight regions (N., E.,
S., W., and NE., SE., SW., NW.), 57^12.
[√diś, ‘to point.’]
